resources.string: Shows while Family Guard parental monitoring is running.
This phone is monitored by a parent/guardian.

A parent or guardian uses Family Guard to see which apps are used, websites visited, and this phone’s location. Monitoring is always on and this app stays visible. No message content, photos, microphone, or camera are collected.
Records the web addresses visited in browsers so a parent can review browsing history. It does not read page content, passwords, or form fields.
